run_phrase_grounding_eval: run the phrase grounding evaluation script with a checkpoint and Flickr dataset path
evaluate_model_with_flickr: evaluate an MDetr phrase grounding model on the Flickr dataset using a postprocessor and evaluator
build_mdetr_phrase_grounding: build an MDetr model for phrase grounding with configurable num_queries and num_classes
load_ema_checkpoint: load an EMA model checkpoint for phrase grounding evaluation with fallback to current model
setup_flickr_evaluation: set up distributed evaluation with FlickrDataModule, FlickrEvaluator, and PostProcessFlickr for phrase grounding
